question: When 55 is subtracted from a number, it reduces to its 80%. Find four-fifth of the original number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 80% = 4/5

here, 55 representing 20% means 1/5 part.

⇒ 4/5 parts = 4 × 55 = 220

∴ four-fifths of the original number is 220.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculation:**

Let original number = a

According to question,

⇒ a - 55 = a x 80/100

⇒ a - 4a/5 = 55

⇒ a = 275

Now, 

275 x 4/5 = 220

**∴ four-fifth of the original number is 220.**
